description: Collecting voice samples for a person: who may collect, add, hear and delete (ADR-0071, ADR-0075).
precondition: Active person with Voice ID consent; collector holds the Thu giọng mẫu hộ capability.

preconditions: A proxy sample exists for the active person.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person; sampleId: a proxy sample of the person.
cases.return: Success with the sample id (MSG474 "Đã xoá giọng mẫu thu hộ.").
cases.log: Saved: sample removed; audit row records the deletion with the proxy scope.

preconditions: The sample is one the person recorded themself.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person; sampleId: the person own self-recorded sample.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; a collector never touches the person own set.
